item.title: A retro console and an AI space game in your browser - BCZ YapZ with Magpie (Shiny Things)
item.description: BCZ YapZ - Magpie spent years in web3 gaming partnerships before going solo in February. His studio, Shiny Things, builds Fable Boy, a retro console that runs in any browser with 30 games, custom skins and leaderboards, and Waypoint, a space game where you own a whole solar system and AI crews fly your fleet. He demos both live, shows Doctrine, a card RTS, and explains why everything runs in the browser with no installs, free to play.

item.title: A shared desktop where you listen to music together - BCZ YapZ with Slava (Base Rooms)
item.description: BCZ YapZ - Slava is a builder, a longtime crypto tinkerer and a former audio producer with a studio in New York City. He brings that studio ethos to Base Rooms: an online desktop with the feel of the early internet, where your Buddy visits a friend's desktop and you listen to music together. Zaal and Slava talk about building every night with AI tools, keeping art and music on chain for good, what that does to a creator's rights, and a live tour of Base Rooms, including a WaveZStation preview player we want to build.

item.title: Fans buy copies of a creator's video, and no AI allowed - BCZ YapZ with Gabriel (Found Some)
item.description: BCZ YapZ - Gabriel is a builder from New York City making Found Some, an app where fans buy copies of a creator's short video. Early buyers pay less, the creator earns from every copy, and AI-made video is not allowed. He got the idea watching the same subway performers for years and asking how the people who value them could back them. Zaal and Gabriel get into how the price curve works, how he trains a model to spot AI video, what Zora got wrong, and why the app says "copies" and never "tokens".

item.title: Quests that pay in stablecoins, and an idea before a token - BCZ YapZ with Danny (P2E Inferno)
item.description: BCZ YapZ - Danny is a full-stack blockchain developer from Nigeria and the builder of P2E Inferno, a live quest platform where communities set actions people can prove they did, and reward them. He lost his front-end job when COVID hit, played Axie Infinity to get by, learned to build through BuidlGuidl and Unlock Protocol bounties, and designed P2E Inferno from what he lived. Zaal and Danny walk through the quests live, talk about the verifier layer he wants to bring to WaveZStation, and then he turns the questions on Zaal about ZAOstock.
